releaseLabel: Build 018 — Availability State Sync & Employee Workflow Specification

branding.primarySlogan: One World. One System. One Intelligent Network.

changes: Fixed availability selector behavior so the status chip label and color update immediately when an employee changes availability.

Added a build-specific implementation and verification checklist for employee work management, follow-ups, professional documents, LinkedIn, progression, intelligent ticket offers, HelpBuddy approvals/signatures, knowledge bases, manager controls, and backend security.

Added a unified Global Search Center above the workspace and Quick Picks, with live filtering of available preview records across users, tickets, devices when present, applications/products, documents, tasks, workflows, meetings/events, and conversations.

verification.inlineJavaScriptSyntax: pending automated validation after global search addition
verification.availabilityStateSync: implemented in preview branch; browser verification pending
verification.employeeWorkflow: existing preview workflow retained; new expanded requirements are documented, not all implemented in this build
verification.backendPersistence: not implemented by this change; existing preview data remains browser-local
verification.securityBoundary: front-end preview only; authentication, role enforcement, shared persistence and live data require backend/services
verification.globalSearch: implemented against browser-local preview state; browser verification pending; not a live shared database search

notes: Build 018 is a preview branch, not yet merged to main. It corrects the immediate availability label/color mismatch and records the full employee workflow acceptance checklist. Do not treat the planned workflows or backend controls as implemented until separately built and tested.
